test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the husband of B

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

Based on the above, how is E related to C if ‘E ÷ F × D − C’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is

 –

 Meaning

 to B
 
 

Given: E ÷ F × D − C

E ÷ F → E is the son of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/763cf1ab99396d07c7052aa5ab0146819c5639b2138e61226f94a45ad2e46e05.png] 

F × D → F is the father of D. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a96e31e29a08f0e363f26f2503b96dae0951d52666237665840ac16b50afcfd.png] 

 

D − C → D is the brother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0c3620b08e82fee01ba93f95731dd088e72367d66d9ff567541450bfeafa8ed.png] 

Thus, E is C's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
